purpose: Teach: 入園/ミニマム/コンソーシアム/原本/諸般/目途/休刊/乗り出す

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署員のお子様の入園を祝われますね
lines.en: So the police department is celebrating an officer's child entering school.
lines.style: Light, observational tone. Warm acknowledgment without fanfare. Soft cadence, as if noticing something genuine in the everyday. Not questioning—affirming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、装備はミニマムに整えられますね
lines.en: And they keep their equipment streamlined and practical.
lines.style: Thoughtful continuation. Slight nod of respect in the delivery. Measured pace. Voice steady, acknowledging competence without over-stating it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯コンソーシアムを率いられますね
lines.en: They lead the community crime-prevention initiative.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact tone. Light emphasis on 'lead'—noting responsibility without making it grand. Conversational, almost understated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の原本を厳格に管理されますね
lines.en: And they manage the original case statements with real rigor.
lines.style: Quiet respect in the voice. Small pause before 'with real rigor.' Not lecturing—acknowledging care in invisible work. Clear articulation on the key phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、諸般の事案にも丁寧に対応されますね
lines.en: They respond to every kind of situation with genuine care.
lines.style: Warm, genuine tone. Slight breath before 'with genuine care'—sincerity building in the final phrase. Not performed; it lands quietly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査終結の目途を市民に知らせられますね
lines.en: They keep the public informed about investigation timelines.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Even tempo. Noting transparency without making it sound unusual. Simple recognition of good practice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察誌の休刊にも対応されますね
lines.en: And they've handled even the magazine going on hiatus.
lines.style: Light, almost wry acknowledgment. Small smile in the delivery. Not dwelling on it—moving past with grace. Conversational, understanding tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新分野の捜査に乗り出す決意ですね
lines.en: They're ready to take on investigations in entirely new areas.
lines.style: Slight rise in energy and conviction on 'ready.' Respect for the commitment. More direct than the previous lines—this one carries admiration and finality. Steady eye-contact level.
